affine_census.scope: Complete connected affine principal-subdiagram census. Every proper principal subset of an irreducible affine Coxeter Gram matrix is positive definite; connected PD subsets are exhaustively extended. Indefinite or already-affine subsets need no extension.

geometry.scope: Only the exact feasible future spacelike certificates prove infinite volume. No absence-of-escape volume conclusion.
